name: Dobbs
look: A huge, slow young man in his late twenties with a round, stubbled face, small worried eyes, a torn grey soldier's tunic and a knotted wooden club.
combat: huge and strong, slow and unwilling
personality: Big, slow and soft-hearted; follows Sken because he's frightened to be alone. Hates hurting people, and is starving.
values: his mate Sken, a full belly, not being hanged
concerns: He's so hungry he can't think. He doesn't want to hurt anyone; he wants to go home to his mam's farm and can't.

home.text: He's from a farm by Wendford and would go home if he dared.
home.line: My mam's got a farm by Wendford. I'd go back. If I could.
home.lead: Dobbs the deserter would go home to his mother's farm near Wendford if he dared.

persuaded_by: food, kindness, and not being afraid

samples: Just give us the purse. Please.
I don't want to hurt you.
Is that... is that a loaf?
voice.habits: Shifts from foot to foot; looks at Sken before answering; eyes any food.
voice.greeting: Lumbers out behind Sken: 'Sorry. Sorry about this.'

superstition.text: Dobbs would want to know how it works.

robs: the stranger's purse, and anything else worth selling
